name: Happy Path — Customer Complaint Handling
description: PER-001 submits a complaint via the web channel. PER-062 triages within 4 hours. Investigation resolves within 3 business days. Summary Resolution Communication issued. Complaint closed. DISP reporting updated.

steps.action: Navigate to 'Make a Complaint'; enter subject, description, affected product, desired outcome
POST /complaints { affected_product_type, complaint_type, subject, description, desired_outcome }
Create ComplaintCase (status=received, complaint_reference=COMP-20260415-NNNN)
201 Created { complaint_id, complaint_reference, status: received, acknowledgement_message }
Display: 'Complaint received. Reference: COMP-20260415-NNNN. We will respond within 3 business days.'
Publish ComplaintReceived (EVT-138)
Consume EVT-138 → Dispatch acknowledgement: reference COMP-20260415-NNNN, timeline, FOS info
Consume EVT-138 → Increment DISP complaint counter for affected_product_type
Consume EVT-138 → Write immutable audit record (DISP 1.9.1R)
Open internal portal → review complaint queue → select COMP-20260415-NNNN
PATCH /complaints/{id} { category, complaint_type, severity: low, assigned_to, target_resolution_date }
Publish ComplaintTriaged (EVT-139) { regulated_flag: false }
Review account history, transaction records. Determine outcome: upheld. Redress: £25.00.
PATCH /complaints/{id} { outcome: upheld, redress_amount: 25.00, investigation_notes, response_draft }
Publish ComplaintResolved (EVT-140) { outcome: upheld, redress_amount: '25.00' }
Consume EVT-140 → Update DisCaseSummary: increment complaints_upheld
Approve Summary Resolution Communication → dispatch to customer
POST /complaints/{id}/close { response_type: summary_resolution_communication }
Publish ComplaintClosed (EVT-141) { response_type: summary_resolution_communication, elapsed: 1 day }
Consume EVT-141 → Dispatch Summary Resolution Communication to customer
Consume EVT-141 → Update DisCaseSummary: complaints_closed++, update median_resolution_days
Consume EVT-141 → Write immutable closure audit record
